If you have 2 Job offers one with 24 Lakhs in Jaipur and the other 40 Lakhs a year in Bengaluru , it's obvious you would pick 40 Lakhs right.
It's certainly better...but what if there is more to this comparison!
So in this video we decided to break down the exact financial impact of living in Bangalore and Jaipur. We included the cost of accommodation, eating out, travel and every other expense which is fundamentally different in each of the cities.
We find out if the real choice is just the number on the packages or the right questions to ask are different.?
